work.abstract_text: We give an alternative proof of Hardin's empirical recurrence and Barker's generating function in OEIS A233156, revision 8 (9 October 2018), FORMULA lines 1 and 2, by reducing them to Biggs and Meredith's double-strip enumeration (1976, Section 3, pp. 10–11). For n >= 3 the labeled three-row array count is exactly 36 times the proper three-coloring count of a 3 by (n-2) rectangular grid. This gives the recurrence for n >= 5 and the complete generating function, including its exceptional initial terms. A direct five-state proof establishes sharp onset and minimal eventual order two. Every displayed row and column recurrence of A233155 and Barker's four-row generating function in A233157 are also proved, with explicit finite integer identities for the larger strips.

work.title: Boundary formulas for Hardin's array recurrences and Barker's generating functions via Biggs–Meredith enumeration
